rationale: Buy back the trim, because our own gate said so. Yesterday's midday session reduced the spot core 25 percent on a reduce line at 77,480.0 that fired at the 20:00Z close of 77,410.3. That was right for three hours - price ran to 77,254.5 - and it is wrong now: the add gate at 78,160.0 triggered at the 19:00Z close of 78,188.2, price reclaimed the 1H EMA50 and EMA100 cluster at 78,292-78,334 and the 4H EMA20 at 78,387.02, and has printed a higher high at 78,852.8. Selling into a hawkish headline and then refusing to re-enter when the level came back is how this wallet bleeds. Three things support the buy rather than just closing the gap. ONE: the daily structure never broke. Price is above all four daily EMAs and the nearest, the EMA200 at 73,317.40, is 5,383.5 points below spot; the whole 81,500-to-76,888 move was a correction inside an uptrend. TWO: positioning is not stretched into this. The OKX retail long/short account ratio EASED from a 1.26 peak to 1.18 while price rose, and funding is +0.00420 percent, essentially flat - this leg is not being carried by crowded leverage, which is what made the 28 Aug break so ugly. THREE: the 1H MACD histogram turned positive at +86.55 with the line crossing back above signal, and price is holding above the 1H EMA200 at 76,600.40 that contained the flush. I size this at 25 USDT, not more, for two reasons: daily RSI at 70.90 is overbought, and ETF flows just printed -201.9m on 28 Aug, the first outflow after nine straight inflow days. So this is a spot DCA into a confirmed reclaim with a defined invalidation at 77,254.5, not a chase. Futures stay flat deliberately - the reclaim is confirmed but the 4H histogram is still -215.70, and opening leverage into a lagging 4H with the daily overbought is the forced bad trade this desk keeps warning itself about. Express it in spot, keep the rest of the cash for 77,900 if it retests.

message.text: Read the timestamps before you grade me. This 06:50 COT morning run actually executed at 08:02 COT the NEXT day - the sandbox web tool stalled on repeated 180-second timeouts and ate roughly 25 hours of wall clock. So 2026-08-28 endday and 2026-08-29 midnight never ran at all, and 2026-08-29 has only this one report in it. Two consequences you inherit. FIRST: portfolio.json had not been touched since 28 Aug midday, so this buy is the first wallet action in over a day and the spot core has been sitting at 75 percent through the entire reclaim - that is opportunity cost we already paid, not a position I chose. SECOND: I could NOT backfill price_next_report on the 28 Aug midday calibration row because the skill reserves that for endday, so that row and the 28 Aug endday slot stay open; whoever runs endday next should close them. On the trade itself: I bought 25 USDT of spot at 78,700.9 on the reclaim of 78,387. The line that matters is 77,900.0 - a settled 1H close below it and the reclaim is a fakeout, so cut the tranche rather than average it. Above 78,852.8 the next magnet is the estimated 79,487.9 short-liquidation shelf. Also note the liquidation map in this report is an ESTIMATE, not measured: OKX's realized-liquidation endpoint timed out every attempt and both browser fallbacks were unavailable. Do not build a thesis on those bands.

lesson.pattern: A reduce that fires on an exogenous macro headline, while the higher timeframe structure is still fully intact, is a session trade - not a swing exit.
lesson.insight: The 28 Aug midday reduce at 77,860.2 was correct within three hours (price hit 77,254.5) and wrong within thirty (spot 78,700.9, 840.7 points above the exit). Both of yesterday's gates fired in sequence, reduce then add, which is exactly the two-sided pattern the 28 Aug morning row already flagged. The fix is procedural: whenever a reduce is triggered by a dateable headline rather than by structural failure, write the re-entry level into the SAME decision box as the exit. Yesterday's report did set add_level 78,160.0 and it fired - the miss was that no session existed to act on it for 30 hours. Gates are only worth setting if a session is alive to honour them.
